lines: +  font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
+h1 { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
+.topbar-inner { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
+.mode-toggle { display: inline-flex; background: #22352d; border: 1px solid #355344; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px; gap: 4px; }
+.mode-btn { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #cfe0d3; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
+.main { max-width: 1240px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 16px 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; flex: 1; }
+.card { background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; }
+.controls { padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
+.controls-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
+.add-city-btn { background: var(--dark); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }

+.add-city-panel { position: absolute; z-index: 40; top: calc(100% + 8px); left: 0; width: 320px; max-width: 86vw; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(20,35,30,.18); overflow: hidden; }
+.add-city-search { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); outline: none; }
+.add-city-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px; max-height: 320px; overflow: auto; }

+.add-city-item { width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; }
+.settings { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: end; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 14px; }
+.setting label, .setting-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
+.setting select { padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; min-width: 150px; }
+.segmented { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px; gap: 3px; }
+.seg { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 650; }
+.legend { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
+.swatch { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
+.summary { background: #eef6f0; border: 1px solid #cfe6d6; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
+.summary-main { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; }
+.summary-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green-dark); }
+.summary-warning { margin: 0; background: var(--amber-bg); border: 1px solid var(--amber-line); color: var(--amber-ink); padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; }
+.range-badge { background: var(--dark); color: #fff; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
+.base-lines { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
+.base-line { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 14px; }
+.desktop-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
+.grid-header-row, .city-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 188px minmax(0,1fr) 34px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
+.grid-corner { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
+.hour-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(24, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 3px; }
+.hour-label { text-align: center; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 650; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }
+.cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(24, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 3px; }
+.cell { text-align: center; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid transparent; }
+.cell--overlap { background: var(--green-bg); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; border-color: var(--green-dark); }
+.city-info { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; flex-wrap: wrap; min-width: 0; }
+.city-name-btn { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; }
+.ref-badge { background: var(--green-dark); color: #fff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .06em; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; }
+.utc-offset { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; background: #eef1ea; border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }

+.remove-btn { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted); display: grid; place-items: center; }
+.hint { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13.5px; margin: 2px 0; }
+.footer { text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; padding: 18px 16px 26px; }
+  .mobile-corner { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; display: flex; align-items: end; }

+  .mobile-city-head { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 6px 2px; background: #f7f8f3; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
+  .mobile-hour-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; }
